responsibility: This file provides tiny cross-component data shared by the LTO front end and linker plugin: printable name tables for LTO symbol kinds, ELF visibility classes, and linker resolution states. Its role is to centralize the stable string representations used when interpreting or diagnosing LTO/plugin symbol resolution metadata.
same_name_distinction: Defines the shared string tables themselves, including LTO symbol-kind and visibility names in addition to resolution names; unlike gcc/lto/common.h, it is the implementation/definition file that provides storage for these printable tables.
